sites.name: Dai Nam Tourist Area (Lac Canh Dai Nam Van Hien)
sites.event: One of Vietnam's leading spiritual and entertainment tourist areas, famous for its gold-plated Golden Temple and large-scale racecourse.

sites.name: Southwest Ben Cat Tunnels (Iron Triangle)
sites.event: A fortified system of tunnels that played an important role in the two resistance wars against the French and Americans in the 'Iron Triangle' region.

place.commune: An Tay Commune, An Dien Commune, Phu An Commune

sites.name: Hoi Khanh Pagoda
sites.event: An ancient pagoda featuring the longest reclining Buddha statue on a temple roof in Asia (at the time of inauguration).

sites.name: Phu Loi Prison
sites.event: Known as 'Hell on Earth', marking the shocking poisoning of political prisoners in 1958.

sites.name: Ba Thien Hau Temple (Ba Pagoda Binh Duong)
sites.event: Famous for the Lady's palanquin procession festival on the full moon of the first lunar month, attracting millions of pilgrims.

sites.name: Lai Thieu Fruit Orchard
sites.event: A fertile land famous for hundreds of years for specialty fruits such as mangosteen and durian.

place.commune: Hung Dinh Ward, An Thanh Ward

sites.name: Dau Tieng Lake
sites.event: The largest artificial irrigation reservoir in Southeast Asia, featuring open natural landscapes suitable for camping.

place.commune: Dinh An Commune, Dinh Thanh Commune, Minh Hoa Commune

sites.name: War Zone D
sites.event: The famous revolutionary base of the Southeast region during the two resistance wars.

sites.name: Tran Van Ho Ancient House (Doc Phu Dau Ancient House)
sites.event: A national-level artistic architectural relic, a typical wooden house of the ancient Southern upper class.

sites.name: Cau Mountain - Thai Son Pagoda
sites.event: A spiritual and natural scenic complex located right next to Dau Tieng Lake.

sites.name: Tan Phuoc Khanh Ceramic Village
sites.event: One of the cradles of Binh Duong's ceramic craft, existing for over 300 years.
